items.title: Use private domain-name targets with Amazon VPC Lattice
items.summary: VPC Lattice now supports private domain-name targets, so you can point a resource configuration at a name that resolves only in a Route 53 private hosted zone or on an on-premises DNS server. This post explains how to choose a DNS resolution type and source, then walks through two deployment patterns for sharing a private service across accounts.
items.creator: Salman Ahmed
